rooms.summary: A warm entry point for the main Therapy House story, philosophy, team and contact paths.
intro: Therapy House is a place for all children, and anyone who has once been a child.
Therapy House is a boutique psychology clinic for people of all ages.
Located in a leafy suburb of Brisbane, the space is purposefully and elegantly designed to make people feel at home.
